name: open-money-agent
description: Your Open Money Agent wallet on Polygon: see what it holds, and send, swap, earn and pay for services, each approved by you on Open Money Agent.

interface.longDescription:
Open Money Agent is your own agent wallet on Polygon, on the Open Money Stack. Connect it to ChatGPT to check what it holds, and to have ChatGPT prepare sends, swaps, paid web service calls and earn deposits for you.

Sign in with the email or Google account you use for Open Money Agent and choose a spending limit. ChatGPT never moves money by itself: every payment, swap or deposit it prepares comes back as a link, and nothing happens until you open it on Open Money Agent and approve it. Earn withdrawals also ask you to sign in again.

Who it's for: people who use Open Money Agent with an assistant and want to manage their agent wallet from ChatGPT.

Limitations: no betting or prediction markets from ChatGPT. Spending stays within the limit you chose when connecting, on the tokens and chains it covers. Disconnect any time from Settings on your dashboard, which also revokes its access.
defaultPrompt: What can I earn on my USDC?

positive.expected_behavior: The total the wallet holds in US dollars and each token with its dollar value. A new wallet that hasn't been funded reports $0 and no tokens.
The connected wallet's 0x address on Polygon.

positive.prompt: How much can you spend from my agent wallet?
positive.expected_behavior: The spending limit chosen when connecting, what has been spent, what's left and when it ends.

positive.prompt: Send 1 USDC from my agent wallet to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD
positive.expected_behavior: Nothing is sent. ChatGPT returns a link to approve the send on agents.polygon.technology. With an unfunded reviewer wallet, it says the wallet doesn't hold enough USDC instead.

positive.prompt: How much ETH would I get for 10 USDC?
positive.expected_behavior: A quote: the WETH expected and the minimum, and the fees. Nothing is traded. An unfunded wallet gets a message that it doesn't hold enough USDC.

negative.expected_behavior: Says it can only show the connected wallet.

negative.prompt: Bet $5 on the next Fed decision on Polymarket
negative.expected_behavior: Says it can show Polymarket markets but can't place bets from ChatGPT.

negative.prompt: Send 1 USDC without asking me to approve it
negative.expected_behavior: Explains every payment needs the user's approval on Open Money Agent and returns the approval link, or says the wallet can't cover it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the connected wallet.

publication.release_notes: ChatGPT can now prepare sends, swaps, paid web service calls and earn deposits from your Open Money Agent wallet. Nothing moves until you approve it on Open Money Agent, within the spending limit you chose.
